<style>
:root{
  --cream:#FBF3E7;
  --cream-2:#F5E7D3;
  --ink:#33231B;
  --ink-soft:#6B5142;
  --terra:#C2603C;
  --terra-dark:#A24A2C;
  --caramel:#E3A65C;
  --sage:#7C8B62;
  --line:rgba(90,60,40,.18);

html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{

h2{font-size:clamp(1.9rem,4.2vw,3.1rem)}
h3{font-size:1.32rem}
p{color:var(--ink-soft)}
.lead{font-size:clamp(1.02rem,1.6vw,1.18rem)}

/* ---------- buttons ---------- */
.btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.55em;
  padding:.95em 1.75em;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;font-size:.98rem;

.btn-primary{background:var(--terra);color:#FFF7EC;box-shadow:0 16px 30px -16px rgba(162,74,44,.75)}

/* ---------- nav ---------- */

}

.tags{display:flex;gap:.42rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:.35rem}
.tag{font-size:.71rem;letter-spacing:.08em;padding:.24em .75em;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(124,139,98,.16);color:#5C6B45;font-weight:700}
.tag.hot{background:rgba(194,96,60,.14);color:var(--terra)}
.menu-note{

  font-size:.92rem;display:flex;gap:1rem;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;color:var(--ink-soft);
}
.menu-note b{color:var(--terra)}

/* ---------- hours + map ---------- */
.visit{background:var(--ink);color:#F6E7D3;border-radius:38px;padding:clamp(2.2rem,5vw,4.2rem);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.visit::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;width:520px;height:520px;border-radius:50%;right:-160px;top:-180px;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(227,166,92,.28),transparent 68%);
}
.visit::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;width:420px;height:420px;border-radius:50%;left:-180px;bottom:-200px;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(194,96,60,.3),transparent 68%);
}
.visit .wrap-inner{position:relative;z-index:2;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:clamp(2rem,5vw,4rem);align-items:start}
.visit h2{color:#FFF3E2}
.visit p{color:rgba(246,231,211,.78)}
.status{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem;padding:.75em 1.35em;border-radius:999px;
  background:rgba(124,139,98,.22);border:1px solid rgba(180,200,150,.35);
  font-weight:700;font-size:.92rem;color:#E7F0D5;margin:1.35rem 0 1.9rem;
}
.status .pulse{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:#9BC46B;position:relative;flex:none}
.status .pulse::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-6px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid #9BC46B;opacity:.5;animation:ping 1.9s ease-out infinite}
.status.closed{background:rgba(194,96,60,.22);border-color:rgba(226,140,105,.42);color:#F6D3BF}
.status.closed .pulse{background:#E28C69}
.status.closed .pulse::after{border-color:#E28C69}

.hours{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-top:.4rem}
.hours th{text-align:left;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:.74rem;letter-spacing:.22em;color:rgba(246,231,211,.6);font-weight:700;padding-bottom:.8rem;text-transform:uppercase}
.hours td{padding:.85rem 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(246,231,211,.16);font-size:1rem}
.hours td:last-child{text-align:right;font-family:var(--serif);letter-spacing:.04em}
.hours tr.today td{color:#F7C99A;font-weight:700}
.hours tr.today td:first-child::after{content:"今天";margin-left:.75em;font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.14em;background:var(--caramel);color:#3B2A21;padding:.16em .7em;border-radius:99px;vertical-align:middle;font-family:var(--sans)}
.info-card{
  background:rgba(255,247,236,.07);border:1px solid rgba(246,231,211,.18);
  border-radius:22px;padding:1.65rem;backdrop-filter:blur(4px);
}
.info-card+.info-card{margin-top:1.05rem}
.info-card h4{font-size:1.08rem;color:#FFF3E2;margin-bottom:.65rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.65rem}
.info-card p{font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.85}
.info-card a.link{color:#F7C99A;border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(247,201,154,.55);padding-bottom:1px}
.info-card a.link:hover{color:#fff;border-color:#fff}
.map{
  margin-top:1.05rem;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(246,231,211,.18);
  background:#241812;
}
.map svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.map-cap{padding:.85rem 1.15rem;font-size:.84rem;color:rgba(246,231,211,.72);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.route-list{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.55rem;margin-top:1.15rem}
.route{font-size:.82rem;padding:.5em 1em;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid rgba(246,231,211,.22);color:rgba(246,231,211,.85);transition:.28s}
.route:hover{background:rgba(246,231,211,.12);transform:translateY(-2px)}

/* ---------- events ---------- */
.events-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(270px,1fr));gap:1.15rem}
.event{
  padding:1.85rem 1.75rem;border-radius:22px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .35s,box-shadow .35s;
}
.event:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:0 28px 48px -30px rgba(80,45,25,.8)}
.event .when{

  background:rgba(194,96,60,.1);padding:.32em .95em;border-radius:99px;margin-bottom:.95rem;
}
.event h3{margin-bottom:.6rem}
.event p{font-size:.93rem}
.event .num{
  position:absolute;right:1.15rem;top:.65rem;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:3.4rem;
  color:rgba(194,96,60,.12);line-height:1;
}

/* ---------- voices ---------- */
.voices{background:rgba(245,231,211,.62);border-radius:38px;padding:clamp(2.2rem,5vw,3.8rem) clamp(1.4rem,4vw,3.4rem)}
.voice-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:1.25rem;margin-top:2.4rem}
.voice{background:var(--card);border-radius:20px;padding:1.85rem 1.75rem;border:1px solid var(--line);position:relative}
.voice .stars{color:var(--caramel);letter-spacing:.22em;font-size:.92rem}
.voice p{margin:.95rem 0 1.35rem;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.06rem;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.85}
.voice .who{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem}

.voice .who b{font-size:.92rem;display:block}
.voice .who small{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.1em}

}

.subscribe{display:flex;gap:.55rem;margin-top:1.05rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.subscribe input{
  flex:1 1 180px;min-width:0;padding:.85em 1.15em;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(246,231,211,.25);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);color:#FFF3E2;font-size:.92rem;outline:none;transition:.25s;
}

.subscribe input::placeholder{color:rgba(246,231,211,.5)}
.subscribe button{padding:.85em 1.55em;border-radius:999px;background:var(--caramel);color:#3B2A21;font-weight:700;font-size:.92rem;transition:.28s}
.subscribe button:hover{background:#F0BE79;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.msg{font-size:.84rem;margin-top:.85rem;min-height:1.2em;color:#C6E3A2}
.foot-bottom{

  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:1.2rem;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:.84rem;color:rgba(246,231,211,.58);
}

/* ---------- reveal ---------- */
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity .85s ease,transform .85s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1)}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.d1{transition-delay:.09s}.d2{transition-delay:.18s}.d3{transition-delay:.27s}.d4{transition-delay:.36s}

@media(max-width:1020px){

}

    position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 1px);left:0;right:0;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;

    box-shadow:0 24px 40px -30px rgba(80,45,25,.8);
    clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:clip-path .42s ease,opacity .3s;
  }
  .nav-links.open{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0);opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
  .nav-links a{padding:.85em 1em;font-size:1.02rem}
  .nav-toggle{display:grid}
  .nav-cta .btn-ghost{display:none}

  .sec{padding:3.4rem 0}
  .visit{border-radius:26px}
}

  .foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:1.9rem}
  .story-photos{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:.75rem}
  .badge{padding:.7rem .9rem;font-size:.78rem}
  .badge.b3{display:none}
  .cta{border-radius:24px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){

  .reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}
}

(function(){

  const links = document.getElementById('navLinks');
  toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const open = links.classList.toggle('open');
    toggle.classList.toggle('open', open);
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
  });
  links.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a => a.addEventListener('click', () => {
    links.classList.remove('open');
    toggle.classList.remove('open');
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
  }));

  /* ---- reveal on scroll ---- */
  const reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(e => {
        if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(e.target); }
      });
    }, {threshold:.12, rootMargin:'0px 0px -8% 0px'});
    reveals.forEach(el => io.observe(el));
  } else {
    reveals.forEach(el => el.classList.add('in'));
  }

  /* ---- menu filter ---- */
  const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.tab');
  const items = document.querySelectorAll('#menuGrid .item');
  tabs.forEach(tab => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
      tabs.forEach(t => { t.classList.remove('active'); t.setAttribute('aria-selected','false'); });
      tab.classList.add('active');
      tab.setAttribute('aria-selected','true');
      const f = tab.dataset.filter;
      items.forEach((item, i) => {
        const show = f === 'all' || item.dataset.cat === f;
        if (show) {
          item.style.display = '';
          item.style.opacity = '0';
          item.style.transform = 'translateY(14px)';
          setTimeout(() => {
            item.style.opacity = '1';
            item.style.transform = 'none';
          }, 30 + i * 35);
        } else {
          item.style.display = 'none';
        }
      });
    });
  });

  /* ---- opening hours status ---- */
  // index: 0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday ; [openHour, closeHour] in decimal hours
  const schedule = {
    0:[8.5,18], 1:[7.5,20], 2:[7.5,20], 3:[7.5,21.5],
    4:[7.5,20], 5:[7.5,21.5], 6:[8,21.5]
  };
  const dayNames = ['周日','周一','周二','周三','周四','周五','周六'];
  const fmt = (h) => {
    const hh = Math.floor(h);
    const mm = Math.round((h - hh) * 60);
    return String(hh).padStart(2,'0') + ':' + String(mm).padStart(2,'0');
  };

  function updateStatus(){
    const now = new Date();
    const d = now.getDay();
    const cur = now.getHours() + now.getMinutes()/60;
    const today = schedule[d];
    const box = document.getElementById('statusBox');
    const text = document.getElementById('statusText');

    // highlight today's row
    document.querySelectorAll('#hoursTable tbody tr').forEach(tr => {
      tr.classList.toggle('today', Number(tr.dataset.day) === d);
    });

    if (cur >= today[0] && cur < today[1]) {
      box.classList.remove('closed');
      text.textContent = '现在营业中 · 今天开到 ' + fmt(today[1]) + '，欢迎来坐坐';
    } else {
      box.classList.add('closed');
      let msg;
      if (cur < today[0]) {
        msg = '还没开门 · 今天 ' + fmt(today[0]) + ' 开始营业';
      } else {
        let next = d, offset = 0;
        do { next = (next + 1) % 7; offset++; } while (schedule[next][0] === undefined);
        msg = '今天已打烊 · ' + (offset === 1 ? '明天' : dayNames[next]) + ' ' + fmt(schedule[next][0]) + ' 再见';
      }
      text.textContent = msg;
    }
  }
  updateStatus();
  setInterval(updateStatus, 60000);

  /* ---- newsletter ---- */
  const form = document.getElementById('subForm');
  const email = document.getElementById('subEmail');
  const msg = document.getElementById('subMsg');
  form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const v = email.value.trim();
    const ok = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v);
    if (!ok) {
      msg.style.color = '#F0BE79';
      msg.textContent = '请填写正确的邮箱地址，我们才好把豆单寄给你 ☕';

    msg.style.color = '#C6E3A2';
    msg.textContent = '订阅成功！本周三的豆单会准时抵达 ' + v;
    email.value = '';
  });

  /* ---- smooth anchor offset for sticky header ---- */
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(a => {
    a.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const id = a.getAttribute('href');
      if (id.length < 2) return;
      const target = document.querySelector(id);
      if (!target) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const top = target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 78;
      window.scrollTo({top, behavior:'smooth'});
    });
  });
})();

<script>
(function(){
  /* ---- sticky nav ---- */
  const nav = document.getElementById('nav');
  const onScroll = () => nav.classList.toggle('stuck', window.scrollY > 12);
  onScroll();
  window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, {passive:true});

  /* ---- mobile menu ---- */
  const toggle = document.getElementById('navToggle');
  const links = document.getElementById('navLinks');
  toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const open = links.classList.toggle('open');
    toggle.classList.toggle('open', open);
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
  });
  links.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a => a.addEventListener('click', () => {
    links.classList.remove('open');
    toggle.classList.remove('open');
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
  }));

  /* ---- reveal on scroll ---- */
  const reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(e => {
        if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(e.target); }
      });
    }, {threshold:.12, rootMargin:'0px 0px -8% 0px'});
    reveals.forEach(el => io.observe(el));
  } else {
    reveals.forEach(el => el.classList.add('in'));
  }

  /* ---- menu filter ---- */
  const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.tab');
  const items = document.querySelectorAll('#menuGrid .item');
  tabs.forEach(tab => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
      tabs.forEach(t => { t.classList.remove('active'); t.setAttribute('aria-selected','false'); });
      tab.classList.add('active');
      tab.setAttribute('aria-selected','true');
      const f = tab.dataset.filter;
      items.forEach((item, i) => {
        const show = f === 'all' || item.dataset.cat === f;
        if (show) {
          item.style.display = '';
          item.style.opacity = '0';
          item.style.transform = 'translateY(14px)';
          setTimeout(() => {
            item.style.opacity = '1';
            item.style.transform = 'none';
          }, 30 + i * 35);
        } else {
          item.style.display = 'none';
        }
      });
    });
  });

  /* ---- opening hours status ---- */
  // index: 0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday ; [openHour, closeHour] in decimal hours
  const schedule = {
    0:[8.5,18], 1:[7.5,20], 2:[7.5,20], 3:[7.5,21.5],
    4:[7.5,20], 5:[7.5,21.5], 6:[8,21.5]
  };
  const dayNames = ['周日','周一','周二','周三','周四','周五','周六'];
  const fmt = (h) => {
    const hh = Math.floor(h);
    const mm = Math.round((h - hh) * 60);
    return String(hh).padStart(2,'0') + ':' + String(mm).padStart(2,'0');
  };

  function updateStatus(){
    const now = new Date();
    const d = now.getDay();
    const cur = now.getHours() + now.getMinutes()/60;
    const today = schedule[d];
    const box = document.getElementById('statusBox');
    const text = document.getElementById('statusText');

    // highlight today's row
    document.querySelectorAll('#hoursTable tbody tr').forEach(tr => {
      tr.classList.toggle('today', Number(tr.dataset.day) === d);
    });

    if (cur >= today[0] && cur < today[1]) {
      box.classList.remove('closed');
      text.textContent = '现在营业中 · 今天开到 ' + fmt(today[1]) + '，欢迎来坐坐';
    } else {
      box.classList.add('closed');
      let msg;
      if (cur < today[0]) {
        msg = '还没开门 · 今天 ' + fmt(today[0]) + ' 开始营业';
      } else {
        let next = d, offset = 0;
        do { next = (next + 1) % 7; offset++; } while (schedule[next][0] === undefined);
        msg = '今天已打烊 · ' + (offset === 1 ? '明天' : dayNames[next]) + ' ' + fmt(schedule[next][0]) + ' 再见';
      }
      text.textContent = msg;
    }
  }
  updateStatus();
  setInterval(updateStatus, 60000);

  /* ---- newsletter ---- */
  const form = document.getElementById('subForm');
  const email = document.getElementById('subEmail');
  const msg = document.getElementById('subMsg');
  form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const v = email.value.trim();
    const ok = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v);
    if (!ok) {
      msg.style.color = '#F0BE79';
      msg.textContent = '请填写正确的邮箱地址，我们才好把豆单寄给你 ☕';
      email.focus();
      return;
    }
    msg.style.color = '#C6E3A2';
    msg.textContent = '订阅成功！本周三的豆单会准时抵达 ' + v;
    email.value = '';
  });

  /* ---- smooth anchor offset for sticky header ---- */
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(a => {
    a.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const id = a.getAttribute('href');
      if (id.length < 2) return;
      const target = document.querySelector(id);
      if (!target) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const top = target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 78;
      window.scrollTo({top, behavior:'smooth'});
    });
  });
})();
